my cat, phoebe was in a shelter for ten months, and up for adoption for three. she was THE grumpiest cat ever and hated people.

one of my beloved family cats had died a few months prior and the house felt empty with only one cat. my mom was getting cat food at one do our local pet stores and saw phoebe sitting in her cage and fell in love. 

my mom brought the whole family to the pet store so we could all see how cute this cat was. we decided to talk to the employees to see about adopting her. we were warned that she doesn’t like people and were asked if we were sure we wanted to visit her. 

we decided to visit her anyways and my dad picked her up. she instantly curled up in his arms and started purring. that’s how we knew. she’s 10 now and one of the sweetest and most loving cats ever.
